subsidy_schemes.name: Subsidie woningisolatie gemeente Apeldoorn
subsidy_schemes.base: insulation works via a home energy adviser; municipality pays the contractor
subsidy_schemes.eligibility: owner-occupier; WOZ value on 1-1-2022 at most EUR 625.000; income below 150% of social minimum; at least two poorly insulated building parts; built in or before 1995
subsidy_schemes.notes: Variants: up to EUR 1.000 back on DIY materials; EUR 1.000 retroactive (invoice at most 12 months old); EUR 1.000, or EUR 1.500 per home for a joint application of at least three addresses in the same or an adjacent 6-digit postcode. Earlier EUR 2.000 recipients can get up to EUR 4.000. The Loenen article says 'tot 100% van de woningisolatie vergoed' and 'tot EUR 500 extra' when neighbours insulate together (https://loenenenergie.nl/isoleren-makkelijker-dan-je-denkt/).

predecessor.value: Stichting Duurzame Projecten Loenen (DPL, 2017-2025), projects and funds transferred to ECL and LEF

cooperative_members_share.value: circa 10% of Loenen's residents are ECL members

households_in_loenen.notes: Not on the site. Scenario's own count: 1,335 residential buildings (1,260 single-dwelling) from 3D BAG via buem.

energy_community_size.notes: User-provided planning figure (2026-11-25); not from the site.

target_energy_neutral.value: Volledige energie-neutraliteit voor Loenen op uiterlijk 1-1-2050

target_gas_free.value: Wijk van de Toekomst: aardgasvrij(-ready), 'stap-voor-stap', no target year
target_gas_free.notes: The van-het-gas-af page quotes a Gelderland goal of homes largely gas-free by 2030.

net_metering_end.notes: See docs/tariffs_nl_2027.md. The site's FAQ still says net metering was extended to 2023 (outdated).

grid_congestion.notes: No figures. A reason for the battery and the flexibility projects.

partners.value: Dorpsraad Loenen; Veluwonen; gemeente Apeldoorn; Provincie Gelderland; Liander; Interreg NWE; Rabobank; OM; TU Eindhoven (SmartCORE); Ecopowercell; deA (energy coaches); REScoop.eu; Energie Samen
